title: Project
description: Something a person could build. A requirement is exactly one of three kinds: a specific part, a capability any part may provide, or a part to be MADE rather than bought. The third fails differently from the other two - shopping cannot fix a bed that is too small - so it is a separate kind rather than a part_id nobody sells.

capability.description: A capability token. Must be provided by at least one registry part, or the project can never be built.

make.description: Name of a part to be fabricated rather than bought. Checked against the machines the user owns, not against the registry.

size_mm.description: Bounding box of the part to be made, mm. Declared by the project author as a design intent; a real design's dimensions come from an OpenDesignCore provenance record instead.

material.description: Material token the part must be made in, e.g. petg. Required: a made part with no material cannot be checked against a machine, and defaulting one would be inventing a design decision.

min_feature_mm.description: Smallest feature the part depends on. Checked against the machine's floor when declared; absent means unchecked, not zero.
